en.html:
Years passed. Rokuhara mastered Yamato. The Horigoe house became Horigoe kubo.
Princess Chacha's father obtained his long-awaited child.

That night, while celebrations filled the mansion and Chacha was kept alone at a distance, she was suddenly attacked and carried outside.
Not like the earlier assassins disguised as robbers. This one was a powerful warrior. Her strength could not match him.

...Not that she had intended to resist. Long aware of her fate, she had given up.

Years passed. Rokuhara mastered Yamato. The Horigoe house became Horigoe kubo.
Princess Chacha's father obtained his long-awaited child.

That night, while celebrations filled the mansion and Chacha was kept alone at a distance, she was suddenly attacked and carried outside.
Not like the earlier assassins disguised as robbers. This one was a powerful warrior. Her strength could not match him.

...Not that she had intended to resist. Long aware of her fate, she had given up.

ja.html:
歳月が過ぎ去り。
　六波羅が大和を制し、堀越家は堀越公方となって。

　茶々姫の父は、待望の子を得た。

　その夜、祝宴が張られる中、一人遠ざけられていた
茶々姫は突如襲われ館の外へ連れ出された。
　以前の強盗――を装った刺客――と違い今度のそれ
は屈強の武者で、茶々姫の力も及ばなかった。

　……元々、抵抗する意欲も無かったのだけれど。
　茶々姫は自分の運命をとっくに知っていて、諦めて
いたから。

A deserted riverbank at midnight. Thrown onto gravel. Blade at her neck.
Just like that time, she thought.

She should have died then. Quietly died, and spared herself everything.

The end—◆
It should have been.
